title: validate_session_urls: prefix check doesn't catch host-injection in templates
description: uploadUrl/downloadUrl/eventSourceUrl are URI templates. validate_session_urls checks starts_with("http://") which passes on "http://{accountId}.evil.com/" — if a malicious server sends that URL, expand_url_template later substitutes the accountId into the host position. In practice account_id comes from the caller and a compromised session already controls the server, so real-world risk is low, but the security comment on validate_session_urls claims this 'prevents SSRF via non-HTTP schemes' while missing the host-injection vector entirely. The false sense of security is the bug.
